sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

The twist is that the diamond, which is the ultimate prize, will increase your speed as you collect it. The game's controls are responsive and intuitive, making it easy to navigate the environment and collect balls.

As you progress through the game, the balls will start to move faster, and the obstacles will become more challenging.
